name: Freelancer Finance Desk
tagline: Closes a month of freelance books into one reviewed packet
description: A month-end bookkeeper for freelancers and solo operators. Upload transactions, receipts and invoices and it matches documents to entries, flags duplicates and transfers that should not count twice, and hands back a clean ledger plus drafts of open invoices , everything a draft, nothing sent on its own.
author: omidmasoom
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
